CSV-105.label: I
CSV-105.reason: This report is about adding a `CSVRecord -> Map` conversion API, which is a record-level convenience feature. The current failure is in `CSVFormat.format(...)` appending an unexpected `"null"` record separator, which is a formatting/output assembly bug in the CSV formatting path. They share the CSV domain, but not the same subsystem or mechanism, so it offers essentially no localization signal beyond very broad package context.
